title: score_backlog.py: add refine vibe + cluster detection for batch execution
description: Two changes to score_backlog.py: (1) add 'refine' as a valid vibe with affinities that boost quality-fix work; (2) add --clusters flag that groups related lugs so Step 9b can dispatch them as batches — reducing file touches and maximizing benefit per session pass.
perceive: score_backlog.py has VIBE_AFFINITY dict with build/fix/think/grind/ship. Vibe 'refine' is now in wai.md but not in the scorer — it fails at runtime. No clustering logic exists. Lugs that share epic, phase sequence, or domain keyword (e.g. impl-ozi-queue-*) are dispatched individually even when batching them would be more efficient.
execute: 1. Add 'refine' to VIBE_AFFINITY: boost other=1.4 (ideas/decisions need triage), feature=1.3 (lug quality), implementation=1.2; suppress epic=0.7, bug=0.6. 2. Add extract_cluster_key(lug_id) function: strip type prefix (feature-/impl-/epic-/bug-/task-/idea-/lug-/policy-/decision-), strip version suffix (-v1/-v2/2026MMDD), take first 2 hyphen-separated words as cluster key. Fall back to epic_id field if present. 3. Add build_clusters(scored) function: group by cluster_key, only cluster when 2+ lugs share a key. Single-lug keys stay solo. 4. Add --clusters flag: when passed, display grouped output with cluster header + members, cluster ROI = max member ROI. 5. Update main() to accept --clusters and route display accordingly.
verify: python3 tools/score_backlog.py refine → exits 0, shows ranked list. python3 tools/score_backlog.py refine --clusters → shows cluster groups. Ozi queue phases (impl-ozi-queue-*) appear as one cluster. Standalone lugs appear solo. No regression on existing vibes (build/fix/think/grind/ship).
acceptance_criteria: python3 tools/score_backlog.py refine exits 0 and shows ranked output
python3 tools/score_backlog.py refine --clusters groups impl-ozi-queue-* as one cluster
Cluster ROI = max member ROI, member count shown
Single-member groups displayed solo (no artificial clustering)
